entries.title: Jonah 4:1
segments: But it [was] a great calamity to Jonah's eye, and it kindled [anger] in him.

entries.title: Jonah 4:2
segments: And he prayed to the LORD and said, Please, O LORD, [was] this not my saying when I was still in my land? On account of this I fled before to Tarshish. For I knew that You [are] a gracious God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and One who repents over calamity.

entries.title: Jonah 4:3
segments: And now, O LORD, I beseech You, take my life from me. For better [is] my death than my life.

entries.title: Jonah 4:4
segments: And the LORD said, Is anger rightly kindled in you?

entries.title: Jonah 4:5
segments: And Jonah went out of the city and sat on the east of the city. And he made himself a booth there and sat under it in the shade, until he might see what would happen in the city.

entries.title: Jonah 4:6
segments: And the LORD God prepared a plant, and it came up over Jonah, to be shade over his head, in order to deliver him from his misery. And Jonah rejoiced [with] great joy over the plant.

entries.title: Jonah 4:7
segments: But God prepared a worm as the morning dawned the next day. And it struck the plant, and it withered.

entries.title: Jonah 4:8
segments: And it happened when the sun shone, God ordained a scorching east wind. And the sun beat on the head of Jonah, so that he fainted. And he asked for his life to die. And he said, Better [is] my death than my life.

entries.title: Jonah 4:9
segments: And God said to Jonah, Is your anger rightly kindled over the plant? And he said, My anger is rightly kindled, [even] to death.

entries.title: Jonah 4:10
segments: And the LORD said, You have had pity on the plant, for which you had not labored, nor made it grow, which was a son of a night, and perished the son of a night.

entries.title: Jonah 4:11
segments: And should I not spare Nineveh, that great city, in which are more than a hundred and twenty thousand men who do not know between [their] right [and their] left hand, besides much cattle?
